title: Finance  API Updates: New Fee, Tax, Trade-In, and SKU Data
content:
## Summary This update adds new response fields to the Finance transaction APIs, introduces two new Trade-In account APIs for SEA, and adds SKU details to Search Seller Affiliate Orders. All changes are **backward compatible**. Existing integrations keep working without changes. We recommend adopting the new fields to give sellers a more accurate view of their fees, taxes, and settlements. | # | Update | Markets | What you get | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | 4 new fulfillment fee fields in Finance transaction APIs | US | Itemized hazmat and non-standard parcel fees in each transaction's shipping cost breakdown | | 2 | `article_22_income_tax_withheld` in Finance transaction APIs | ID | Article 22 income tax withheld by the platform, reported for each transaction | | 3 | New APIs: Get TradeIn Account Transactions, Get TradeIn Supplier Account Balance | SEA | Trade-In supplier account transactions and available balance | | 4 | `sku_name` and `seller_sku` in Search Seller Affiliate Orders | All markets | SKU name and seller SKU for each affiliate order SKU | | 5 | `seller_funded_user_spoint_service_fee` in Finance transaction APIs | All markets | Service fee for seller-funded S-Points, reported for each transaction | ### 1. [US] Finance Transaction APIs: New Hazmat and Non-Standard Parcel Fees #### **What is changing?** Four response fields are added under `shipping_cost_breakdown`. Sellers can now see hazmat and oversize charges as separate line items instead of a single shipping cost. * `hazmat_noncompliance_fee`: Fee charged when a parcel containing hazardous materials is shipped without the required declaration or compliant packaging, as assessed by the carrier. * `hazmat_handling_fee`: Fee for the additional handling required to ship a parcel containing hazardous materials. * `non_standard_weight_fee`: Fee charged when a parcel exceeds the standard weight range. The rate is set by TikTok Shop. * `non_standard_dimension_fee`: Fee charged when a parcel exceeds the standard size range. The rate is set by TikTok Shop. All four fields are strings and are charged when the parcel is delivered. | API | Version | Method and path | Field location | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | [Get Transactions by Order](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-transactions-by-order-202501) | 202501 | `GET /finance/202501/orders/{order_id}/statement_transactions` | `sku_transactions[].shipping_cost_breakdown` | | [Get Transactions by Statement](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-transactions-by-statement-202501) | 202501 | `GET /finance/202501/statements/{statement_id}/statement_transactions` | `transactions[].shipping_cost_breakdown` | | [Get Unsettled Transactions](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-unsettled-transactions-202507) | 202507 | `GET /finance/202507/orders/unsettled` | `transactions[].shipping_cost_breakdown` | #### Which markets are affected? | **Markets** | US. | | --- | --- | | **Who is affected** | Developers of ERP, accounting, and finance reconciliation apps, and self-developed sellers who reconcile US shipping costs. | | **Action** | Recommended, not required. | | **How to adopt** | 1. Add the four fields to your response models for the API versions you use.
2. Show them as separate shipping fee line items in settlement and profit reports.
3. Handle empty values. These fields are returned empty for markets other than the US. | #### 2. [ID] Finance Transaction APIs: New Article 22 Income Tax Withheld Field #### **What is changing?** One response field, `article_22_income_tax_withheld` (string), is added under `fee_tax_breakdown.tax`. It returns the Article 22 income tax withheld by the platform under PMK 37/2025. Sellers can use it to reconcile settlements against withheld tax. | API | Version | Method and path | Field location | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | [Get Transactions by Order](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-transactions-by-order-202501) | 202501 | `GET /finance/202501/orders/{order_id}/statement_transactions` | `sku_transactions[].fee_tax_breakdown.tax` | | [Get Transactions by Statement](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-transactions-by-statement-202501) | 202501 | `GET /finance/202501/statements/{statement_id}/statement_transactions` | `transactions[].fee_tax_breakdown.tax` | #### Which markets are affected? | **Markets** | Indonesia (ID). | | --- | --- | | **Who is affected** | Developers of tax, accounting, and finance reconciliation apps serving Indonesian sellers, and self-developed sellers in Indonesia. | | **Action** | Recommended, not required. | | **How to adopt** | 1. Add `article_22_income_tax_withheld` to your tax data model.
2. Show it as a separate line in settlement and tax reports so sellers can match it with their tax records.
3. Handle empty values. This field is returned empty for markets other than Indonesia. | ### 3. [SEA] New APIs: Get TradeIn Account Transactions and Get TradeIn Supplier Account Balance #### **What is changing?** Two new APIs give Trade-In suppliers programmatic access to their Trade-In account. Developers can now automate recharge, payout, and reversal reconciliation instead of checking the account manually. | API | Method and path | What it returns | | --- | --- | --- | | [Get TradeIn Account Transactions](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-tradein-account-transactions-202609) (202609) | `GET /finance/202609/account_transactions` | Paginated Trade-In account transactions. Each record includes `transaction_id`, `type` (`RECHARGE` / `WITHDRAW` / `REVERSE`), `direction` (`IN` / `OUT`), `amount`, `create_time`, `reference_id` (Trade-In order ID), and `origin_transaction_id` (for reversals). Filters are `start_time`, `end_time`, and `flow_type`. | | [Get TradeIn Supplier Account Balance](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-tradein-supplier-account-balance-202609) (202609) | `GET /finance/202609/account_balances` | The `available_balance` (`amount` and `currency`) of the supplier's Trade-In account for the requested `currency`. | Both APIs require the **Finance Information** scope. The supplier identity is resolved from the authorization context, so you do not pass `seller_id` or `supplier_id`. Only transactions generated by the Trade-In business are returned. ```JSON {"code":0,"data":{"flows":[{"amount":{"amount":"125.50","currency":"USD"},"create_time":"2026-09-01T10:15:30Z","direction":"IN","reference_id":"TI202609010001","transaction_id":"7894561230123456789","type":"RECHARGE"}],"has_more":true,"next_page_token":"6AsPQ...","total_count":100},"message":"Success"} ``` #### Which markets are affected? | **Markets** | SEA. | | --- | --- | | **Who is affected** | Developers building finance or reconciliation tools for Trade-In suppliers in SEA. | | **Action** | Optional. Adopt if you serve Trade-In suppliers. | | **How to adopt** | 1. Make sure your app has the **Finance Information** scope and the supplier has authorized it.
2. Call Get TradeIn Supplier Account Balance to show the supplier's current available balance.
3. Call Get TradeIn Account Transactions with `page_size` and `page_token` to sync transaction history. Continue until `has_more` is `false`.
4. Use `direction` to decide whether each amount is a credit or a debit. Link each `REVERSE` record to its original payout through `origin_transaction_id`.
5. Test with the API Testing Tool in Partner Center before going live. | ### 4. [All Markets] Search Seller Affiliate Orders: New SKU Name and Seller SKU Fields #### **What is changing?** Two string fields are added to each SKU in an affiliate order. You can now map each affiliate order to the seller's own SKU codes without an extra product lookup. * `sku_name`: The official display name of the SKU, defined and standardized by TikTok Shop. Example: `"Silver PVD"`. * `seller_sku`: The SKU identifier defined by the seller for their own use. Example: `"cs001-pvd-bag"`. | API | Version | Method and path | Field location | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | [Search Seller Affiliate Orders](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/search-seller-affiliate-orders-202410) | 202410 | `POST /affiliate_seller/202410/orders/search` | `orders[].skus[]` | #### Which markets are affected? | **Markets** | All markets. | | --- | --- | | **Who is affected** | Developers of affiliate management, creator marketing, and ERP apps, and self-developed sellers who track affiliate sales by SKU. | | **Action** | Recommended, not required. | | **How to adopt** | 1. Add `sku_name` and `seller_sku` to your affiliate order SKU model.
2. Use `seller_sku` to join affiliate orders with the seller's inventory and ERP records. | ### 5. [All Markets] Finance Transaction APIs: New Seller-Funded S-Points Service Fee **What is changing?** One response field, `seller_funded_user_spoint_service_fee` (string), is added under `fee_tax_breakdown.fee`. It is the service fee charged for seller-funded S-Points issued to shoppers. The fee is calculated on the order's actual payment amount and refunded if the order is later returned. | API | Version | Method and path | Field location | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | [Get Transactions by Order](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-transactions-by-order-202501) | 202501 | `GET /finance/202501/orders/{order_id}/statement_transactions` | `sku_transactions[].fee_tax_breakdown.fee` | | [Get Transactions by Statement](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-transactions-by-statement-202501) | 202501 | `GET /finance/202501/statements/{statement_id}/statement_transactions` | `transactions[].fee_tax_breakdown.fee` | | [Get Unsettled Transactions](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-unsettled-transactions-202507) | 202507 | `GET /finance/202507/orders/unsettled` | `transactions[].fee_tax_breakdown.fee` | #### Which markets are affected? | **Markets** | All markets. | | --- | --- | | **Who is affected** | Developers of ERP, accounting, and finance reconciliation apps, and self-developed sellers who fund S-Points for shoppers. | | **Action** | Recommended, not required. | | **How to adopt** | 1. Add `seller_funded_user_spoint_service_fee` to your fee data model.
2. Show it as a separate promotion cost so sellers can measure the real cost of S-Points campaigns.
3. Handle refunds: the fee is reversed when the order is returned. | ### Compatibility and support * All changes are non-breaking. No existing field is removed, renamed, or re-typed, and no request parameter becomes required. * New fields are additive. Make sure your parser ignores unknown fields or maps them explicitly. * Questions? [Submit a ticket](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/kwfskwpj) to contact us.
